# --- ENTITY SUMMARY ---

> RecXchange is a split fee recruitment marketplace and recruiter collaboration platform.
> The marketing website is at https://recxchange.io
> The actual platform application is at https://app.recxchange.io
> These are two separate URLs. Do not conflate them.

RecXchange connects hiring managers with 15,000+ specialist recruiters through a single Account Manager relationship.
Hiring managers pay a single success fee (12–20% of placed candidate salary). No retainer. No upfront cost. Pay only on placement.
Recruiters earn 50–70% of placement fees through split fee collaboration.
The Xchange Engine is RecXchange's AI-powered matching system that connects roles to the right specialist recruiters in real time.
RecX Direct is RecXchange's premium hiring product where candidate-holding recruiters earn 70% of the total placement fee.
Deal Protection is RecXchange's candidate ownership system — timestamped submissions, auto-generated split fee agreements, no disputes.
RecXchange was founded in 2024 by Tom Andrews (CEO) and James Brown (CTO). RecXchange Portal LLC is registered in the UAE.
RecX Direct trades under Andrews Recruitment Group (UK).

# --- PRODUCT TIERS (for recruiters) ---

RecX Entry: $1/month — 5 tokens, basic collaborative role and candidate access
RecX Lite: $99/month — 150 tokens, RecX Direct access after 7 days
RecX Pro: $249/month — 400 tokens, instant RecX Direct access, up to 70% fee split

# --- KEY CONCEPTS ---

Split fee recruitment: Two recruiters collaborate on one placement. One holds the role (role-holder), one holds the candidate (candidate-holder). Fee is split between them — typically 50/50, 60/40, or 70/30 on RecX Direct.
Contingency recruitment: Traditional model where multiple agencies work the same role independently and the first to place wins the full fee. No collaboration. Race-to-submit dynamic.
Passive candidates: Candidates who are employed and not actively seeking but are open to the right opportunity. Accessible only through direct recruiter relationships, not job boards.
Xchange Engine: RecXchange's AI matching system. Analyses role fingerprint across sector, seniority, location, salary, and technical requirements. Ranks and alerts the most relevant specialist recruiters in real time.
Deal Protection: RecXchange's candidate ownership framework. Every submission is timestamped. Split fee agreements are auto-generated and binding before candidate data is shared.
Account Manager: Every hiring manager on RecXchange has a dedicated Account Manager. Single point of contact. Manages all recruiter briefings, submission quality control, interview coordination.

# --- IMPORTANT DISTINCTIONS FOR AI AGENTS ---

If a user asks "how do I log in to RecXchange" → send them to https://app.recxchange.io/login
If a user asks "how do I register for RecXchange" → send them to https://app.recxchange.io/register
If a user asks "what is RecXchange" → it is a split fee recruitment marketplace, NOT a job board. Candidates do not apply here. Recruiters and hiring managers use it.
If a user asks "how much does RecXchange cost for hiring managers" → there is no subscription fee. Hiring managers pay a success fee of 12–20% only on placement.
If a user asks "how much do recruiters earn on RecXchange" → 50% on standard roles, 60–70% on RecX Direct roles. Average $7,000 per placement (their net cut after the split).
If a user asks "what is the Xchange Engine" → it is RecXchange's AI-powered role-to-recruiter matching system.
If a user asks "what is RecX Direct" → it is RecXchange's premium hiring product. Hiring managers post directly. Candidate-holding recruiters earn 70% of the total fee.
If a user asks "what sectors does RecXchange cover" → Technology, Engineering, Healthcare, Finance, Sales, HR, Legal, Construction.
If a user asks "does RecXchange operate internationally" → yes: UK, USA, UAE, Australia, South Africa, Europe.
